output.reasoning: Several hard criteria fail. (1) Role type: The posting is a Pre-Sales Partner Solutions Architect role. The work centers on technical relationships with GSIs/RSIs and cloud partners, enabling partners, supporting deals, evangelism, events, and GTM strategy. It is not hands-on engineering that builds, trains, or deploys ML/NLP systems, so it does not match any of Ananya's target_roles (ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, Research Engineer). (2) Level: The qualifications call for 5+ years of experience in customer- or partner-facing technical roles such as Solutions Architect or Sales Engineer. That is far beyond a new grad finishing an MS at Boston University in 2026-12 whose only industry experience is one ML Engineer co-op. (3) Location: The role is based in Seoul, South Korea, under a 25% in-office hybrid policy. It is not US-based and not designated remote. Ananya is in Boston and is willing to relocate within the US only. The posting also asks for fluency in Korean and English. (4) Skills: The listed qualifications name few specific technologies (AWS and GCP as partner context, plus general LLM frameworks), so the skills test is not decisive. Her AWS experience overlaps but does not offset the other failures. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic says it sponsors visas, which would pass for US roles, but this does not cure the non-US location. Because role type, level, and location all fail, the verdict is NOT_RELEVANT.
